prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production skill-tree node icons (round medallion emblems) for a dark fantasy 2D action RPG whose heroine Lirian is a crimson-moon swordswoman. Image1 is the existing skill icon sheet of this game: match its painterly dark fantasy rendering, black-crimson mood, silver blades, glowing light and sharp detail, but each new icon is a ROUND MEDALLION, not a square card. Create ONE transparent RGBA square image (2048x2048 or larger) with exactly SEVEN separate round emblems in an invisible 4 columns x 2 rows grid, filled left to right, top row first; the bottom-right cell stays completely EMPTY. Each emblem is a perfect circle centered in its own cell, filling about 70% of the cell, with wide transparent margins, never touching other emblems or the canvas edge. Every emblem: a thin metal rim (blood-crimson enamel rim with dark iron; warm gold rim), a dark inner disc, and ONE bold simple central symbol that stays readable when shrunk to 20 pixels (strong silhouette, high contrast, little clutter). Outside the circles: actual alpha transparency, no background, no floor, no shadow, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no characters or faces.
EMBLEMS in order: (1) crimson rim: a sword tip with a long reaching light ray. (2) crimson rim: a demon-sword spirit flame shaped like a blade. (3) gold rim: a sword crossed with a shield, warrior spirit. (4) gold rim: a gust of wind with a blade riding it. (5) gold rim: a winged running boot with dash lines. (6) gold rim: a ghostly afterimage of a dashing swordswoman silhouette shape made only of three fading blade outlines (no face). (7) LARGEST, radiant gold ornate rim: a glowing crimson moon with a silver sword vertically through its center, the heart of the tree.
